data.name: Vishanu
data.gender_notes: Vishanu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Vishanu signifies the protector of the world. It is one of the names of Lord Vishnu, the preserver deity in Hinduism. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vish' meaning protection and 'Nu' meaning new or young. Thus, Vishanu is the young protector or the preserver. The name Vishanu carries the meaning “Protector of the World” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vishanu usually hope their child will grow to embody protector of the world and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Vishanu represents the divine aspect of protection and preservation. It is believed that invoking the name of Vishanu can bring peace and security in one's life.
data.etymology: Vishanu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector of the World.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vishanu total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vishanu holds significant cultural importance in Hinduism. It is a revered and powerful name associated with Lord Vishnu, who is believed to preserve and sustain the universe. The name is also associated with the famous festival of Dussehra, where Lord Vishnu is worshipped as Vamana Avatar, also known as Vishanu, who protected the world from the demon King Mahabali by displacing him from the throne temporarily. The name is celebrated and chanted during rituals and religious ceremonies.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Vishanu represents the protective and nurturing aspect of God. It is a reminder of the divine presence that shields us from harm and provides us with protection and sustenance. The name also signifies the idea that we are constantly protected and cared for by a higher power, even in times of hardship and uncertainty. The name Vishanu inspires faith, devotion, and a sense of safety and security in the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vishnu is the preserver and protector in the Hindu trinity. His name signifies the power of protection and preservation, symbolizing the eternal cycle of destruction and creation. Vishnu's compassionate nature ensures the continuance of life.
